description: Which tokens are being paid-promoted right now, and are they rugs? Reads DexScreener's boost feed (newest or most boosted), keeps tokens on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon and Solana, and risk-checks up to 5: 0-100 score, avoid/caution verdict, top reasons, simulated sell, liquidity, deployer's past launches, boost size and the token's X account. Not advice. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base via x402.

chain.description: Only this chain; default all six

feed.description: latest: newest boosts (default); top: tokens with the most active boosts
